spec.context: FINAL-BUNDLE retake (light, top of page). Fixes to verify: identity name now renders "Dr. Varun Malik" (the honorific parity fix — the website renders "Dr. X" on profile pages; bare names read as inconsistent next to prefixed similar-doctor rows); quiet stats now read "1 visit · 0 patients on Aturseva" (singular/plural grammar fix — was "1 visits"). Judge: name treatment, stats grammar, rest of the top frame (fee block ₹350 first visit, clinic hours) unchanged and clean.

defects.what: Honesty violation: review card shows apparent QA/test data on a patient-facing surface — review title 'QA updated' by 'QA Mobile Patient · 18 Oct 2026'. This reads as internal test content, not real patient feedback.
defects.where: Ratings card, review row under the 4-star strip

defects.what: Back pill button appears under 44px tall (~36–40px estimated height).

measured_notes: Name fix verified: identity block renders 'Dr. Varun Malik' with the Dr. honorific, matching prefixed similar-doctor convention.

Quiet stats row ('1 visit · 0 patients on Aturseva') is NOT visible in this capture — top frame shows identity → fee → clinic hours → ratings → CTA, so the singular/plural fix cannot be verified from this screenshot.

Fee block: '₹350' renders very large (~40px+), 'first visit' secondary, 'Pay at the clinic — no advance payment.' grey on #F4F4F2 — hierarchy by scale is correct; grey-on-tint contrast estimated ~4.6–5:1, passes AA.
Clinic hours: 7 rows, Monday–Wednesday and Sunday greyed 'Closed' (~#666 on white, est. ~5.5:1, passes), Thu–Sat bold with '10:00 – 13:00' — no truncation.
Ratings: '4.0 · 1 review' bold, 4 filled stars + 1 empty star consistent with 4.0.
Sticky CTA 'Book appointment — ₹350' spans full width minus 16px gutters, ~56–60px tall, well above 44px.
16px screen gutters and consistent card radius (roughly 12–16px) appear consistent across fee, hours, and ratings cards.
non_blocking_notes: Review row title 'QA updated' vs reviewer line uses two greys of slightly different weight — fine once real review data replaces test data.
Avatar 'DV' initial chip is quiet and on-palette; no fabricated accent colors observed.
No teal accent visible in this frame — acceptable since nothing here is live/selected.
verdict.one_line: Name fix and layout are clean, but QA test review data ('QA updated' / 'QA Mobile Patient') leaking into the patient-facing ratings card is a blocking honesty violation, and the quiet-stats fix is unverifiable from this capture.
